World guide

Three worlds share one horizon.

The Fracture overlays places that should never meet. Each reality changes the rules of energy, memory and identity.

Reality A

Meridian City

A vertical coastal metropolis powered by solar glass and public transit rings. It is the story's human anchor.

Reality B

The Verdant Engine

A living machine-world where buildings grow, adapt and remember every person who enters.

Reality C

Null Dominion

A silent geometric empire that removes uncertainty by erasing every possible alternative.

Rules of the rift

The overlap is strongest at sunset. Powers intensify near mirrored surfaces, but each use leaves an echo that the Null Crown can follow.

Archive note

The universe is intentionally original. Its visual language references general comic grammar - panels, captions, bursts and halftone texture - without copying a commercial franchise.
